svg.title: Variance is decided by which positions a type parameter appears in
svg.desc: Three rows. IEnumerable of out T is covariant because T appears only in an output position, the return type of a member producing a T. Action of in T is contravariant because T appears only in an input position, a method parameter. IList of T is invariant because T appears in both an input position, Add of T, and an output position, the indexer getter, so it can be neither covariant nor contravariant.
